name: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3
description: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 is Mistral's flagship speech-to-text model, with speaker diarization and timestamps. Mistral reports it ahead of Whisper large-v3, GPT-Transcribe, Scribe v2, and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe on its transcription benchmarks, and it also handles translation, speech Q&A, summarization, and function calling. It is in public preview.

sources.notes: Official model identity, version, public-preview status, transcription route, and $0.004 per-minute price. The card shows October 20, 2026 as its date, used here as the release date.
Endpoint-level transcription parameters (language, temperature, stream, diarize, context_bias, timestamp_granularities).

verification.notes: Identity, price, and route verified against Mistral's model card. Parameter support is taken from the shared transcription endpoint reference; the card does not list it per model.
